chapters.title: What Dax Did Not Say
chapters.opening_condition: Mae and Dax leave the maintenance rib with the stolen anchor-heart after freeing the tagged glass skate; Mae's right sleeve is torn over a rib compression wrap, Dax's coral cape is scorched at the hem, his breath-knot is spent, and both have seen an engine chain embedded in a juvenile keelback.
chapters.objective: Cross Hook Market during an induced gravitational lean and carry the anchor-heart to a route where its evidence can be secured.
chapters.closing_turn: After Dax admits he used Mae to reach evidence his dead crew found years ago, Mae rejects both him and Orra's offer of command and walks away carrying the dented anchor-heart alone.

sequences.title: The Calf's Chain
sequences.setting: The outer maintenance rib above Hook Market, where a grated service ledge overlooks awnings beginning to pull east toward the wall-sea.
sequences.objective: Document the chain entering the juvenile keelback before the changing lean hides it.
sequences.constraint: The ledge is narrowing under eastward pull, the freed glass skate is exhausted, and the anchor-heart must remain level in its triangular cradle.
sequences.action: Mae braces the cradle against a rib pin while Dax uses his barometer gauntlet to align the chain's vibration with the coming market bell; the juvenile rolls, pulling the chain taut enough to expose a stamped Crown coupling.
sequences.consequence: They confirm the animal is part of the civic load system, but the taut chain transmits a warning shudder into the market supports below.
irreversible_state: The Council's Crown coupling on the juvenile keelback has been witnessed by both Mae and Dax.
The maintenance-rib shudder has begun propagating into Hook Market.
Mae retains the torn right sleeve and rib compression wrap; Dax retains the scorched cape hem.

lettering.speaker: dax
lettering.text: Then the city has been riding its ribs.
Below, Hook Market leaned toward the sea.

sequences.title: Market on a Hinge
sequences.setting: Hook Market's braided walkways, packed with shuttering stalls, hanging scales, and adults hauling goods toward inland braces.
sequences.objective: Move the anchor-heart across the market before the induced lean reaches full force.
sequences.constraint: The eastward tilt steepens by the minute, the cradle needs two carriers, and loose carts now roll across their route.
sequences.action: Mae clips the cradle to a stall's main cable and feeds it hand over hand while Dax clips his scorched cape between an awning frame and the cart's brake lever, making a drag sail that slows the descending cart.
sequences.consequence: The cart misses the cradle and blocks the public stair instead; Dax's cape pulls loose with a stretched collar, and the pair must take his concealed route through the scale arcade.
irreversible_state: Dax still has no stored breath-knot after expending it in the maintenance rib.
Dax's scorched cape now has a stretched collar from braking the cart.
The public stair is blocked by a loaded market cart.
Mae and Dax commit to the concealed scale-arcade route.

lettering.speaker: dax
lettering.text: This cape still owes me one brake.

sequences.title: The Route He Knew
sequences.setting: The enclosed scale arcade, a triangular passage of suspended weigh pans and old forecast marks hidden behind market shutters.
sequences.objective: Traverse the arcade and reach its inland loading door with the anchor-heart intact.
sequences.constraint: Counterweight pans sweep across the sloped passage, knot crows peck at charged harness cords, and Dax knows the timing too precisely to conceal prior use.
sequences.action: Dax calls each pan before it swings; Mae pins one with her marlinspike, creating a rigid step, but knot crows sever the cradle's upper lashing and the anchor-heart strikes the pan's iron rim.
sequences.consequence: Mae catches the heart before it falls, yet its casing gains a deep triangular dent; the old crew marks beside Dax's hand expose his connection to the route.
irreversible_state: The anchor-heart casing is dented at one triangular corner.
The cradle's upper lashing is severed and cannot bear full load.
Mae has seen Dax's former crew mark inside the concealed arcade.

lettering.speaker: dax
lettering.text: Third pan. Duck on the return.

sequences.title: Forecast Debt
sequences.setting: A wedged service alcove at the end of the scale arcade, with the damaged cradle lashed to a fixed plumb column.
sequences.objective: Repair the cradle enough to move while Mae demands the full history of Dax's evidence.
sequences.constraint: The induced lean loads the repair cord continuously, and every omitted fact now reads as another attempt to remove Mae's choice.
sequences.action: As Mae splices the lashing, Dax admits his crew discovered the animal-chain years ago, died after the Council falsified their forecast, and that he approached Mae because only her municipal seal could open the rib.
sequences.consequence: Mae finishes a safe splice but refuses Dax's offered hand; the operational partnership continues only until they clear the failing arcade.
irreversible_state: Mae knows Dax selected and used her for access to the evidence.
Dax has admitted the Council forecast falsification connected to his dead crew.
The anchor-heart cradle has a temporary lower-capacity splice.

lettering.speaker: dax
lettering.text: My crew found the chain eight years ago.

lettering.speaker: dax
lettering.text: Your seal was the door. I chose you for it.

sequences.title: Cape in the Gears
sequences.setting: The arcade's inland loading bridge as its hinge pins shear above the tilted market square.
sequences.objective: Get Mae and the anchor-heart across the opening bridge before it folds into the market.
sequences.constraint: The patched cradle cannot take a shock, Mae's bruised ribs limit her reach, and a jammed hinge holds the bridge at a widening angle.
sequences.action: Dax wraps his coral cape around the toothed hinge and throws his weight backward; the cloth jams the gear long enough for Mae to slide the heart along a tensioned handline and cross, then tears free into the machinery as Dax jumps.
sequences.consequence: Both land inland and the heart remains secured, but Dax permanently loses the long tail of his cape while its torn coral collar wrap remains; the released bridge crashes behind them, sealing the route.
irreversible_state: Dax's long coral cape tail is torn away and lost in the collapsed bridge gears; its short torn collar wrap remains.
The scale-arcade route is sealed by the fallen loading bridge.
Mae and the dented anchor-heart have reached the inland side.

sequences.title: Command Weight
sequences.setting: An inland market plumb court, emptied by the lean and bounded by Crown load-armor crews holding fixed safety lines.
sequences.objective: Decide who will carry the anchor-heart and what authority Mae will accept after the crossing.
sequences.constraint: Orra controls the safe Crown route, Dax cannot restore Mae's consent, and South Hook remains marked for detachment at dawn.
sequences.action: Orra offers Mae command of the Crown repair corps in exchange for the heart; Mae unclips Dax from the patched cradle, shoulders its load herself, and walks out through an unsecured labor passage.
sequences.consequence: Mae separates from Dax and refuses Orra's bargain, but carries the heavy, damaged heart alone toward Crown works to test Orra's claimed arithmetic.
irreversible_state: Mae and Dax's working trust is ruptured.
Mae has explicitly refused Orra's offer of command on Orra's terms.
Mae leaves with sole custody of the dented anchor-heart; Dax remains in the market court with only the torn coral collar wrap.

lettering.speaker: orra
lettering.text: Take command. Bring me the heart.

chapters.title: A Better Kind of Obedience
chapters.opening_condition: Mae, carrying the dented anchor-heart alone, has refused Orra's conditional command but enters Crown works to verify the sacrifice calculation; Dax, stripped of the long cape tail but still wearing its torn coral collar wrap, returns to South Hook with no breath-knot and no claim on Mae's trust.
chapters.objective: Verify Orra's load math, keep South Hook alive through the dawn detachment order, and put the true sacrifice plan where the city can see it.
chapters.closing_turn: Mae leaks the load map and becomes a fugitive; after Dax helps South Hook organize without manipulation, Eshe reveals that the original lattice was designed for thousands of voluntary human nodes.

sequences.title: Inside the Plumb
sequences.setting: Crown works intake, a black triangular chamber of counterweighted lifts and guarded load rails.
sequences.objective: Gain physical access to the calculation floor without surrendering the anchor-heart.
sequences.constraint: Orra's crews control every lift, the patched cradle is unsafe for a vertical ascent, and Mae's rib wrap tightens under the heart's weight.
sequences.action: Mae seats the dented heart in a freight counterweight and clips her own harness to its opposite rail, forcing the lift into balance; Orra permits the ascent because removing Mae would drop the evidence through the shaft.
sequences.consequence: Mae reaches the calculation floor with the heart under joint mechanical custody rather than Council possession.
irreversible_state: The dented anchor-heart is installed temporarily in the Crown freight counterweight.
Mae has entered the restricted calculation floor under guard.
Mae's injured ribs remain compressed and strained by the ascent.

sequences.title: No Clever Version
sequences.setting: South Hook communal kitchen and evacuation yard, where carts, water casks, and cook tables are being lashed to inland rails.
sequences.objective: Convince Tavi and the district to prepare for detachment before dawn.
sequences.constraint: Dax arrives without Mae, proof, cape, or stored craft, and Tavi recognizes his habit of selling confidence instead of facts.
sequences.action: Dax places his gauntlet and empty frayed breath cord on Tavi's table, states the worst forecast without a joke, and lets Tavi choose the evacuation order; Tavi assigns him to inventory every usable line.
sequences.consequence: South Hook begins an adult-led evacuation, while Dax accepts work without controlling the decision or the message.
irreversible_state: Tavi has issued a South Hook evacuation order based on Dax's unvarnished warning.
Dax's barometer gauntlet is temporarily pledged to Tavi's forecast table.
Dax is publicly accountable for the district's line inventory.

lettering.speaker: dax
lettering.text: Gone because I made truth arrive late.

lettering.speaker: dax
lettering.text: At dawn, this district loses down.

lettering.speaker: tavi
lettering.text: Good. No clever version. Count rope.

sequences.title: Arithmetic of Absence
sequences.setting: The Crown calculation floor, where brass plumb arms trace district loads across a physical saltglass relief map.
sequences.objective: Reproduce Orra's stability calculation directly from the mechanical map.
sequences.constraint: The map assumes detached districts contribute zero lives and zero resistance, while Orra frames that omission as necessary engineering discipline.
sequences.action: Mae moves South Hook's load token back into the model and routes its predicted fall through empty service rails; the model stabilizes only when thousands of peripheral counterweights are deliberately omitted.
sequences.consequence: Mae verifies that the Crown can survive only because the official model assigns the fatal load to uncounted districts, not because no alternative structure exists.
irreversible_state: Mae has personally reproduced the Council's sacrifice plan on the physical load map.
The South Hook token now remains seated in the active model, exposing its previously hidden load path.
Orra knows Mae will not accept the model's definition of stability.

lettering.speaker: mae
lettering.text: South Hook is absent from the sum.

lettering.speaker: orra
lettering.text: It is outside the survivable structure.

sequences.title: Lines Without a Hero
sequences.setting: South Hook's sloping evacuation lanes between the communal kitchen and inland mooring towers.
sequences.objective: Move essential supplies and mobility-limited adults inland before the district's assigned weight is withdrawn.
sequences.constraint: There are fewer intact ropes than carts, knot crows are stealing charged offcuts, and Dax cannot substitute performance for a trustworthy plan.
sequences.action: Dax sorts lines by tested load and marks every uncertainty; Tavi turns cook-table trestles into sled brakes, then assigns pairs of adults to each rope while Dax uses uncharged scrap to lure knot crows away.
sequences.consequence: The first evacuation column moves under distributed control, and Dax becomes one accountable rigger among many rather than its indispensable rescuer.
irreversible_state: South Hook's intact ropes are labeled by verified load and assigned to named teams.
The first evacuation column has departed for the inland mooring towers.
Tavi's cook-table trestles have been converted permanently into sled brakes.

lettering.speaker: dax
lettering.text: If I cannot prove it, it goes in unknown.

lettering.speaker: tavi
lettering.text: Pairs on every line. Nobody carries alone.

sequences.title: The Bell Prints the Map
sequences.setting: The Crown works bell gallery above Veyr, connected to the calculation floor by load rods and public warning cables.
sequences.objective: Publish the true load distribution through infrastructure every district can physically read.
sequences.constraint: Guards are climbing from both ends, the map cannot be carried, and transmitting its full pattern will overload the public bell cables.
sequences.action: Mae locks the anchor-heart into the gallery distributor, aligns the altered relief map beneath its pins, and drops the master hammer; each district bell receives a pulse proportional to the load stolen from it, embossing the pattern into their saltglass witness strips.
sequences.consequence: The city receives durable physical proof, but the overloaded Crown cable snaps, scorches Mae's municipal seal, and makes her sabotage publicly identifiable.
irreversible_state: Every connected district possesses a saltglass witness strip embossed with the true diverted load map.
The Crown public-bell cable is snapped and cannot carry routine warnings.
Mae's municipal seal is scorched into the transmission record, making her a named fugitive.
The dented anchor-heart remains locked in the bell-gallery distributor.

lettering.speaker: orra
lettering.text: A map without command becomes panic.

sequences.title: Original Instructions
sequences.setting: An abandoned ferry shed at the boundary between Crown and South Hook, its roof ropes trembling with the citywide bell pulse.
sequences.objective: Regroup around the leaked evidence and identify a survivable alternative to Orra's detachment plan.
sequences.constraint: Mae is hunted, Dax has no standing to ask for trust, the anchor-heart is still inside Crown works, and the copied map shows more load than the district's hardware can bear.
sequences.action: Dax reports Tavi's distributed evacuation without asking Mae's forgiveness; Eshe steps from the archive ferry with an original lattice fragment showing thousands of hand-tied node marks and matches it to the fresh witness strip.
sequences.consequence: The four learn the city was designed around voluntary living nodes, and Eshe declares that the complete consent protocol is stored in an archive about to flood sideways.
irreversible_state: Eshe has openly joined Mae, Dax, and Tavi with forbidden original-lattice evidence.
The group knows the civic lattice was designed for thousands of voluntary nodes.
Mae and Dax share a mission again without restored trust or forgiveness.
The complete consent protocol is located in the endangered Crown archive.

lettering.speaker: dax
lettering.text: Tavi chose the lines. I counted them.

lettering.speaker: eshe
lettering.text: You are all reading a copy of a copy.

lettering.speaker: eshe
lettering.text: The instructions are in an archive filling with sea.

chapters.title: The Archive Has Tides
chapters.opening_condition: Mae is a named fugitive, the anchor-heart is locked inside Crown works, South Hook is evacuating, and Eshe has revealed that the original voluntary-node protocol lies in a Crown archive already flooding sideways.
chapters.objective: Retrieve and authenticate the consent protocol before sideways seawater destroys it, choosing civic evidence over personal revenge.
chapters.closing_turn: With the protocol recovered and Mae and Dax beginning a strictly practical repair, the decoded instructions identify the original living Span beneath Veyr.

sequences.title: Siblings at the Intake
sequences.setting: The archive ferry intake, where a narrow maintenance skiff hangs from wall rails above water climbing horizontally from the east.
sequences.objective: Enter the sealed archive without alerting Crown patrols to Eshe's defection.
sequences.constraint: The public lift is locked, Dax's gauntlet remains pledged at South Hook, and the ferry rail is buckling under sideways water pressure.
sequences.action: Eshe ties her saltglass-edged yellow archive sash between two rail braces while Dax shifts their weight in time with each pressure surge; the improvised span holds long enough for them to hand-winch the skiff through the service hatch.
sequences.consequence: They enter unseen, but Eshe's official sash tears into two load-bearing strips and can no longer disguise her as a loyal archivist.
irreversible_state: Eshe's archive sash is torn into two functional yellow saltglass cord strips.
Eshe can no longer use the intact sash as proof of Crown loyalty.
Dax and Eshe are inside the flooding archive without his barometer gauntlet.

lettering.speaker: eshe
lettering.text: You left me the slow work.

sequences.title: Shelves Become Keels
sequences.setting: The archive's tide stacks, long aisles of brass document cages with seawater flowing sideways across the eastern wall.
sequences.objective: Reach the foundation records at the archive's deepest western index.
sequences.constraint: Sideways current makes the floor useless, loose cages drift like rams, and glass skates entering through cracked vents startle at hard vibration.
sequences.action: Eshe reads the cage-number ribs while Dax turns a fallen shelf into a keel; they pull along its upper edge, tapping a slow rhythm so the skates move ahead rather than collide with them.
sequences.consequence: They reach the western index without harming the animals, but the fallen shelf redirects current into the return aisle and closes their original exit.
irreversible_state: A fallen archive shelf now diverts the sideways flood through the return aisle.
The intake route is no longer a viable exit.
Several glass skates have entered the archive through failed sea vents.

lettering.text: The archive kept its own tide tables.

lettering.speaker: dax
lettering.text: Soft taps. They follow pressure, not us.

sequences.title: One Case or the City
sequences.setting: The western black-rib vault, where two sealed cases hang from a tilting index spindle above the cross-current.
sequences.objective: Choose and recover the case containing the original consent protocols.
sequences.constraint: The spindle can lower only one case before water reaches the release gear; the second holds signed orders proving Orra personally buried Dax's crew forecast.
sequences.action: Dax reaches first for Orra's orders, stops when Eshe names the cost, then cuts that case's suspension line so its counterweight raises the heavier protocol case into their hands.
sequences.consequence: The revenge evidence vanishes into the flooded stacks, while the civic protocol case is saved and Dax's choice becomes physically irreversible.
irreversible_state: Orra's signed suppression orders have been sacrificed to the archive flood.
Dax has chosen the citywide consent protocol over evidence useful for personal revenge.
Dax and Eshe possess the sealed foundation-protocol case.

sequences.title: Witness Cords
sequences.setting: A vertical catalog shaft beside the vault, now half-filled by a rotating column of water and loose index plates.
sequences.objective: Carry the protocol case up the shaft to the roof vent before the vault submerges.
sequences.constraint: The case requires two hands, Dax has no stored breath left, and the yellow sash strips can hold either the case or the siblings, not both separately.
sequences.action: Eshe loops one sash strip through both harnesses and the other around the case, explicitly asking Dax to share the pull; together they time their climb to the glass skates' buoyant wakes and survive the same rotating load.
sequences.consequence: The synchronized tension charges both yellow strips with visible pull marks, creating authenticated witness cords and lifting the case within reach of the roof vent.
irreversible_state: Dax and Eshe have consciously survived and shared one synchronized archive load.
The two yellow sash strips are now charged witness cords marked by their shared pull.
The protocol case has reached the roof-vent platform.

sequences.title: Repair, Not Forgiveness
sequences.setting: The archive roof vent above the ferry canal, where Mae waits on a suspended maintenance cradle as floodwater tears panels from the wall.
sequences.objective: Transfer the siblings and protocol case from the failing vent to Mae's cradle.
sequences.constraint: Mae has only a short uncharged line, Dax's new witness cords must remain intact as evidence, and the vent frame is peeling away under sideways pressure.
sequences.action: Mae knots her short line through the protocol case's triangular index handle, while Dax anchors the free end around his bare shoulder; their old working rhythm returns just long enough to swing Eshe and the case into the cradle.
sequences.consequence: All three escape as the vent tears free, and Mae reties Dax's line for safety without forgiving the deception that broke them.
irreversible_state: Mae, Dax, Eshe, and the protocol case have escaped the flooded archive.
Mae and Dax have resumed limited practical cooperation without restored trust.
Dax retains both charged yellow witness cords, the torn coral collar wrap, and no barometer gauntlet.

lettering.speaker: mae
lettering.text: Case first. Eshe second. You last.

lettering.speaker: mae
lettering.text: This is a repair. Not forgiveness.

sequences.title: The Node Beneath
sequences.setting: A dry mooring loft above the archive canal, where Tavi waits as the protocol sheets are pinned between rope battens and lit by acid-yellow witness cords.
sequences.objective: Authenticate the recovered protocol and identify how to activate a voluntary civic lattice.
sequences.constraint: Water has blurred portions of the diagram, its vocabulary predates modern burdencraft, and the central symbol was deliberately scraped from later copies.
sequences.action: Eshe aligns the sheets by puncture marks, Mae reconstructs the load paths with cord, Dax lays the two witness cords across matching consent gates, and Tavi recognizes the repeated hand-knot as a caller's acceptance pattern.
sequences.consequence: The complete routing resolves around a living Span beneath the city, proving the voluntary network requires reaching and waking that buried node.
irreversible_state: The original consent protocol has been physically authenticated by archive marks and charged witness cords.
The group knows a living Span exists beneath Veyr and is required to restore the voluntary lattice.
Tavi has identified the protocol's acceptance pattern as shared-load calling.
Dax now wears the yellow witness cords as public evidence of the recovered protocol.

lettering.speaker: eshe
lettering.text: These punctures predate the Council seal.

lettering.speaker: tavi
lettering.text: That knot asks. It does not take.

lettering.speaker: mae
lettering.text: Every route meets below the city.
